description.value: Booster Juice is a Canadian smoothie and fresh juice chain offering blended-to-order drinks, açai bowls, and light food items. As a juice bar focused on nutritious, high-energy beverages, it could serve as a convenient refuelling stop for touring cyclists. This location is in Nanaimo, BC, in a unit-addressed commercial space.
